name: ai-memory
description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
one_liner: A shared notebook for AI coding assistants: it remembers what you were working on and lets you switch between different AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) without re-explaining everything.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small dev team who wants everyone's AI coding sessions to share project context instead of each developer re-explaining the codebase to their assistant every day.
business_use_cases: A dev team self-hosts one memory server so every engineer's coding agent shares the same project knowledge and handoff notes.
A freelance developer runs it locally to resume AI-assisted projects across laptops without losing prior context.
A consultancy offers 'AI agent setup' packages for clients that include configuring shared memory across their engineering org.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed/hosted version of the memory server with team auth and audit logs for engineering orgs.
Sell 'AI coding agent onboarding' consulting that includes setting this up for a client's dev team.

steal_this: This is a developer-infrastructure tool, not something to resell as-is; the realistic weekend project is offering a done-for-you setup/consulting session for teams already using multiple AI coding CLIs.
